_what_this_is: Engineering method text the kernel injects into isolated model workers, per role.
Workers run the Claude Code CLI with --bare, an empty strict MCP configuration and slash
commands disabled. They load no plugins, hooks, skills or project settings. Any discipline a
worker follows must therefore arrive as plain text in its prompt. This manifest is the only
source of that text. Each entry names where the idea came from and how it was adapted.
source_sha256 is null where the upstream text was not fetched at authoring time: what is
pinned is the adapted text in this directory, which the security guard protects.

methods.adaptation: Ponytail's ladder as an ordered decision procedure; shortest diff is a tie-breaker, never an authority; accessibility and security are excluded from minimisation.
codebase-design as instructions for a worker that must name seams and planned files for a deterministic governor.
Vertical-slice implementation discipline inside a frozen external acceptance contract; the worker cannot run commands, so the loop is read-and-reason.
Red loop first; the kernel executes the repro, the worker proposes it and separates facts from hypotheses.
The Spec axis of the two-axis review, bound to the validated contract and compiled design.
The Standards axis of the two-axis review, extended with the minimal-complexity and dependency rules the factory enforces.
